name: drift_spectrum
reference_instrument: Li et al., arXiv 2509.23024 — RankMe, alpha-ReQ (definitions only)

model.comment: bottleneck d < n_classes as the order requires; d small enough that A3 alignment can brute-force d! permutations

data.comment: class k drawn with probability proportional to (k+1)^-skew; control is uniform

measure.comment: every step until dense_until, then every `every` steps; identical schedule on every seed so A3 has matched steps

axes.A1_window_source: the only defined window in the repo: Monitor.detect_cost_spike / recent_trend, all 10 steps (INVENTORY.md §1)
axes.A2: hidden-unit rows (L1) and output-unit rows (L2) of one per-step delta
axes.A3: theta_t - theta_0 across seeds at matched step; raw and hidden-unit-permutation-aligned

repair_flags.comment: the repo's two flag rules re-implemented; theta_0 stands in for theta_ref, which is NOT the repo's scenario (INVENTORY.md §6)

phase_detector.comment: [CHOICE] three-phase = trough below start, peak above trough, end below peak, each by margin_frac of the smoothed range

alignment.comment: [CHOICE] LOCKED corr >= +t at |lag| <= tol; ANTI-PHASE corr <= -t; else DECOUPLED. Only computed when S4 licenses it.

what_was_swept_before_freezing: probe distribution: uniform over classes AND drawn from the training distribution (the reference instrument's own choice)
learning-rate schedule: constant AND linear decay to 0.05*lr
calibration_record.what_the_sweep_found: collapse then expansion appears under skew in every small-init setting and is weak or absent in the control; a compression phase (RankMe falling after its peak) appeared in NO setting. The frozen values are the setting where the two reproduced phases are clearest, not a setting where the third appeared, because none did.
calibration_record.rule: generator settings were chosen to reproduce the REFERENCE channel's published shape (S4), which is the licensing condition. Nothing about the drift axes was looked at while choosing them.
